items: Updates are checked before they replace anything, and nothing is replaced while the game runs.
Beta updates in Settings (off unless you switch it on).
Tools > Roll back to previous version.
Your friend's cockpit now matches the game: HUD, map with zoom, cockpit buttons and pages, weapon box, compass, STAT and STATUS pages, squad list with specialties, all in the game's own font
Lock works like the game's: units under the crosshair, coloured IFF brackets, lock light, target camera
Sound on the guest's side: game sounds from his point of view, radio voices, subtitles and music
Briefing videos and launch cinematics on both screens
His own infrared, full view (G) and 360 view
One map marker per player, the host's in orange
Smoother guest view and lower delay
His own settings: sound and music, subtitles, zoom, crosshair, HUD colours, mouse buttons
His shots go where his crosshair points and leave from his own gun, with his own weapon and jet sounds
Both players pick their gear at the same time
Still experimental: for the guest, drone, A.S.F. and guided missiles are not there yet
Squad orders no longer stall when a friend plays one of your squadmates
Clear message when Steam is missing (Retry / Exit), and when a friend runs another version
Graphics presets: Original, Classic+, Modern, Light, with a preview of every setting
New installs start in the modern look (old school is one click away)
See your own legs and feet when you look down, including on slopes
Footprints for every suit and continuous tracks behind vehicles
Cloud shadows that follow the clouds, soft edges
Sky without lines, smoke drawn from the game's own particles
Impact marks, light from shots, cliffs, sharp stars (each can be turned off)
Ground tiles keep their own edges, no more stray pixels over the view
Squadmates look right from any angle
Drone screen fills its panel, "DRONE RECALLED" shown like in the game
Esc opens Uplink's menu: game menu, controls, graphics, options, accessibility, quit
Order wheel: hold a button, pick an order, choose who gets it with the mouse wheel; "move there" stops in front of walls
Click on the HUD map to place your marker
Gamepad support for solo, host and guest, with remapping
Photo mode on L
Squadmates' subtitles
Colour-blind modes: protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia
Subtitle size: normal, large, larger
New design, graphics page with previews, controls page with keyboard, mouse and gamepad
Music choice: Roland / GS, FM, game's own or AWE32 (with your own ROM dump)
Safer updates: checked downloads, roll back, beta channel
Needs Terra Nova Plus 1.2.7
